description: A social media manager needs a cropped version of Hokusai's Great Wave painting for use as a profile banner. Open the image /home/ga/Documents/krita/great_wave.png in Krita. Using the crop tool or Image > Crop to Selection, crop the image to exactly 640 pixels wide and 480 pixels tall, starting from the top-left corner of the image. Export the cropped result as /home/ga/Documents/exports/great_wave_cropped.png.

metadata.source_artwork: Hokusai - The Great Wave off Kanagawa (1831)
